examples.name: Default
examples.summary: An overview's usage strip: four StatTiles in one card, split by dividers, each delta aligned to the end of its cell. One cell per row in a narrow box, two from the group's medium size, all four in a row on a wide one.

examples.name: BesideCard
examples.summary: A dashboard row: the usage strip beside a taller card. The row stretches the group to the card's height and the cells share it, so no empty band sits under the tiles.
